contracts: getGlyphsUntil(index) includes index, ignores null glyphs and preserves first encounter order in LinkedHashSet; Glyph.equals checks exact runtime class, left/top and RunTable.equals, not just object identity
Glyph selection does not filter by contrib or item kind; zero-contrib linker stumps still participate
getGlyphsUntil(-1) is empty; invalid positive index is not silently clipped
getLastGapBefore(index) searches backward starting index-1, excluding the indexed item
Item tokens must map to physical glyph equality (including run-table orientation) and same-owner registry aliases before grade/cache; item token is not a physical ID
Original createStem registers physical glyph before grade/rejection and reuses cached object regardless of valid later profile/image
Automatic target endpoint selection, whole-page shared cache/head/SIG and contextual epilog are separate dependencies
